description: 把GROUP BY里的常量分离出去，改为先按非常量列分组，再在外层补常量列。

examples.original_query: SELECT 'Department' AS label, deptno, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emp GROUP BY deptno, ('Department'::text)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT 'Department' AS label, deptno, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emp GROUP BY deptno

description: 把SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN x END)改写为SUM(x) FILTER (WHERE ...)。

examples.original_query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN deptno = 10 THEN salary END) AS sum_dept10 FROM emp
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT SUM(salary) FILTER (WHERE deptno = 10) AS sum_dept10 FROM emp

description: 把同一列上的多个DISTINCT聚合重写为更易实现的一组GROUP BY/聚合组合。

examples.original_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT deptno) AS dept_cnt, SUM(DISTINCT salary) AS salary_sum FROM emp
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN grp = 1 THEN deptno END) AS dept_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN grp = 2 THEN salary END) AS salary_sum FROM (SELECT deptno, NULL::numeric AS salary, 1 AS grp FROM emp GROUP BY deptno UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS deptno, salary, 2 AS grp FROM emp GROUP BY salary) AS g

description: 将包含多个DISTINCT聚合的查询拆成多个子聚合，再用JOIN合并结果。

examples.original_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT deptno) AS dept_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT job) AS job_cnt FROM emp
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT d.dept_cnt, j.job_cnt FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT deptno) AS dept_cnt FROM emp) AS d CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT job) AS job_cnt FROM emp) AS j

description: 把WHERE/HAVING过滤条件尽量下推到聚合前，减少参与聚合的数据量。

examples.original_query: SELECT deptno, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM emp GROUP BY deptno HAVING deptno > 10
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT deptno, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM (SELECT * FROM emp WHERE deptno > 10) AS s GROUP BY deptno

description: 在多表LEFT JOIN + GROUP BY结构中，删除对结果无影响的冗余JOIN。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT id FROM t2 GROUP BY id) AS t2u ON t1.id = t2u.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT id FROM t3 GROUP BY id) AS t3u ON t1.id = t3u.id GROUP BY t1.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t1 GROUP BY t1.id

description: 在单层JOIN + GROUP BY结构中，如果右表列没被聚合实质使用，就去掉该JOIN。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT id FROM t2 GROUP BY id) AS t2u ON t1.id = t2u.id GROUP BY t1.category
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t1 GROUP BY t1.category

description: 将只依赖单边表的聚合提前到JOIN之前执行，再在JOIN后做必要的汇总。另一侧的过滤能明显减少被聚合的行时，先过滤再聚合，不要对全表预聚合。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id, SUM(t2.amount) AS total_amount FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.t1_id GROUP BY t1.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.id, SUM(t2_agg.sum_amount) AS total_amount FROM t1 JOIN (SELECT t1_id, SUM(amount) AS sum_amount FROM t2 GROUP BY t1_id) AS t2_agg ON t1.id = t2_agg.t1_id GROUP BY t1.id

description: 合并嵌套的两个GROUP BY聚合为一个更简单的聚合。

examples.original_query: SELECT SUM(sum_salary) AS total_salary FROM (SELECT deptno, SUM(salary) AS sum_salary FROM emp GROUP BY deptno) AS dept_sum
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM emp

description: 把紧挨着聚合的纯投影合并进聚合或去掉多余的SELECT。

examples.original_query: SELECT deptno, sum_salary FROM (SELECT deptno, SUM(salary) AS sum_salary FROM emp GROUP BY deptno) AS s
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT deptno, SUM(salary) AS sum_salary FROM emp GROUP BY deptno

description: 把AVG等聚合改写成SUM/COUNT组合。

examples.original_query: SELECT AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM emp
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT SUM(salary) / NULLIF(COUNT(salary), 0) AS avg_salary FROM emp

description: 如果GROUP BY不做真正聚合，或者输入本身已经DISTINCT，则去掉不必要的GROUP BY。

examples.original_query: SELECT empno FROM (SELECT DISTINCT empno FROM emp) AS d GROUP BY empno
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT empno FROM (SELECT DISTINCT empno FROM emp) AS d

description: 把UNION ALL + GROUP BY的去重场景改写为UNION。

examples.original_query: SELECT x FROM (SELECT x FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT x FROM t2) AS u GROUP BY x
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT x FROM t1 UNION SELECT x FROM t2

description: 在一侧已有GROUP BY的UNION ALL + GROUP BY场景下，整体改写为UNION。

examples.original_query: SELECT x FROM (SELECT x FROM t1 GROUP BY x UNION ALL SELECT x FROM t2) AS u GROUP BY x
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT x FROM t1 UNION SELECT x FROM t2

description: 把聚合下推到UNION ALL的每个分支。

examples.original_query: SELECT deptno, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT deptno FROM emp_us UNION ALL SELECT deptno FROM emp_cn) AS u GROUP BY deptno
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT deptno, SUM(cnt) AS cnt FROM (SELECT deptno, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emp_us GROUP BY deptno UNION ALL SELECT deptno, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emp_cn GROUP BY deptno) AS s GROUP BY deptno

description: 对固定的VALUES子句做聚合时，直接在常量上算出结果而不真的扫描表。

examples.original_query: SELECT SUM(x) AS sum_x FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) AS t(x)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT 6 AS sum_x

description: 把只依赖分组键的过滤从聚合后移到聚合前，减少聚合输入。该过滤必须对这个聚合结果的每一次使用都成立。另有使用处不能带上同一过滤时，不要推进这段共享聚合，也不要复制一份聚合来单独过滤。

examples.original_query: SELECT deptno, SUM(sal) AS total_sal FROM emp GROUP BY deptno HAVING deptno = 10
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT deptno, SUM(sal) AS total_sal FROM (SELECT * FROM emp WHERE deptno = 10) AS s GROUP BY deptno

description: 相关子查询里只依赖外层的过滤提到子查询外面；外连接或 LATERAL 输入上的过滤下推到该输入端。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id AND t1.id > 5)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 WHERE t1.id > 5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id)
examples.example_description: 覆盖相关子查询中只依赖外层输入的Filter提取到子查询外侧。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id, sub_t2.val FROM t1 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t2.val FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id) AS sub_t2 ON TRUE WHERE t1.id > 5
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1_filtered.id, sub_t2.val FROM (SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE id > 5) AS t1_filtered LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t2.val FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1_filtered.id) AS sub_t2 ON TRUE
examples.example_description: 覆盖外连接相关输入上的Filter下推到左侧输入端。

description: 把IS NOT DISTINCT FROM这类空值敏感比较展开成等价的普通布尔表达式。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE x IS NOT DISTINCT FROM y
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE x = y OR (x IS NULL AND y IS NULL)

description: 将只依赖某一侧输入的 WHERE 条件推入该侧：可并入 INNER JOIN 的 ON，或推入该侧子查询/派生表。推入子查询时只投影后续需要的列，不要用 SELECT * 包住大表。本规则只做谓词下推与列裁剪，不改变连接写法与连接条件集合。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.val > 100
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id AND t1.val > 100
examples.example_description: 只依赖左表的 WHERE 条件并入 INNER JOIN 的 ON。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.name FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t2.status = 'ACTIVE'
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2_filtered.name FROM t1 JOIN (SELECT id, name FROM t2 WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS t2_filtered ON t1.id = t2_filtered.id
examples.example_description: 只依赖一侧的 WHERE 推入该表子查询，并只投影后续需要的列。

description: 把多层连续的WHERE合并成一层WHERE，或合并多个Filter节点。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM t WHERE a = 1) AS s WHERE b = 2
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM t WHERE a = 1 AND b = 2

description: 在SELECT计算列之后再过滤时，尽量把过滤移到原始列上，并前置到投影之前。

examples.original_query: SELECT a_plus_1 FROM (SELECT a, a + 1 AS a_plus_1 FROM t) AS s WHERE a > 10
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT a + 1 AS a_plus_1 FROM (SELECT * FROM t WHERE a > 10) AS s

description: 简化WHERE里的常量或恒真/恒假条件（比如1=1、1=0），并把能算出结果的日期、数值常量表达式折成常量。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM t WHERE 1 = 1 AND id > 5
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM t WHERE id > 5
examples.example_description: 删除WHERE中的恒真表达式。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM t WHERE 1 = 0 AND id > 5
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM t WHERE 1 = 0
examples.example_description: 识别恒假表达式，保留等价的空结果过滤。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM t WHERE d <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '93' day
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM t WHERE d <= date '1998-08-30'
examples.example_description: 把日期加减折成日期常量。

description: 把WHERE条件从外层UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT后移到各个输入子查询中。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT id FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM t2) AS u WHERE id > 10
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT id FROM t1 WHERE id > 10 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM t2 WHERE id > 10
examples.example_description: UNION ALL外层过滤下推到各分支，保留重复行语义。

description: 同一相关键上同时有 EXISTS（存在其他键）和带额外谓词的 NOT EXISTS（不存在其他满足该谓词的键）时，即使子查询表很大，也用本规则。外层已经要求的额外谓词写进聚合输入的 WHERE，再按相关键聚合，用「满足该谓词的键恰好一个」替代 NOT EXISTS。不要把该谓词只写在 FILTER 里，也不要对未过滤的全表做 GROUP BY 或 DISTINCT。EXISTS 若必须看不满足该谓词的行，就保留为 EXISTS，不要并进这次聚合。只有子查询数据量较小且去重成本低时，才把单个 IN/EXISTS 改写为 JOIN + DISTINCT。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 WHERE t1.id IN (SELECT t2.id FROM t2)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM t2 WHERE id IS NOT NULL) AS sub_t2 ON t1.id = sub_t2.id
examples.example_description: IN子查询改写为JOIN + DISTINCT；显式过滤NULL以保持IN的三值逻辑过滤语义。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM t2 WHERE id IS NOT NULL) AS sub_t2 ON t1.id = sub_t2.id
examples.example_description: EXISTS相关子查询改写为JOIN + DISTINCT；去重后避免右表多匹配放大左表行数。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 WHERE t1.mark = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 WHERE t2.ref = t1.ref AND t2.flag = 1 AND t2.key <> t1.key) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 WHERE t2.ref = t1.ref AND t2.flag = 1 AND t2.key <> t1.key AND t2.mark = 1)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 JOIN (SELECT ref, MIN(key) AS marked_key FROM t2 WHERE flag = 1 AND mark = 1 GROUP BY ref HAVING MIN(key) = MAX(key)) AS sub_t2 ON t1.ref = sub_t2.ref AND t1.key = sub_t2.marked_key WHERE t1.mark = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 WHERE t2.ref = t1.ref AND t2.flag = 1 AND t2.key <> t1.key)
examples.example_description: 额外谓词 mark 写入聚合的 WHERE，用 MIN(key) = MAX(key) 替代 NOT EXISTS。必须看不满足 mark 的行时，EXISTS 保留，不要并进这次聚合。

description: 过滤TABLE FUNCTION结果时，尽可能把条件提前到函数输入上。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM generate_series(1, 10) AS g(x) WHERE x > 5
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM generate_series(6, 10) AS g(x)

description: 对VALUES生成的常量行集过滤时，直接在VALUES里删掉不满足条件的行。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b')) AS t(id, name) WHERE id = 1
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'a')) AS t(id, name)

description: 把INTERSECT改写为INTERSECT ALL+外层去重或等价的DISTINCT结构。

examples.original_query: SELECT id FROM t1 INTERSECT SELECT id FROM t2
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT DISTINCT id FROM (SELECT id FROM t1 INTERSECT ALL SELECT id FROM t2) AS s

description: 在 JOIN 前增加一个半连接，让一侧先被过滤，再做真正的 JOIN。半连接内侧应是选择性高的小结果。不要让同一张大表先被半连接扫描，再被相同键的 JOIN 扫描一次。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id, t2.name FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.k = t2.k WHERE t2.flag = 'Y'
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1s.id, t2.name FROM (SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 WHERE t2.k = t1.k AND t2.flag = 'Y')) AS t1s JOIN t2 ON t1s.k = t2.k AND t2.flag = 'Y'
examples.example_description: 半连接内侧是带选择性谓词的小表，随后仍连接它取出需要的列。大表不要用这种方式扫两遍。

description: 把可以提前的连接条件推向输入表或JOIN的ON子句以减少中间结果。

examples.original_query: SELECT s.*, t2.* FROM (SELECT * FROM t1) AS s JOIN t2 ON s.id = t2.id AND s.val > 10
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT s.*, t2.* FROM (SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE val > 10) AS s JOIN t2 ON s.id = t2.id
examples.example_description: 覆盖将只依赖左输入的JOIN条件推入左侧输入表子查询。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 CROSS JOIN t2 WHERE t1.id = t2.id AND t1.val > 10
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id AND t1.val > 10
examples.example_description: 覆盖将过滤形式的连接条件推入JOIN的ON子句。

description: 从JOIN条件中推导出某些列IS NOT NULL的约束，加入过滤。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.id IS NOT NULL AND t2.id IS NOT NULL

description: 把内连接变为笛卡尔积+过滤形式，便于优化器统一处理Filter。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.id = t2.id

description: 当左输入是UNION ALL时，把JOIN分发到每个分支，再用UNION合并。

examples.original_query: SELECT u.id, t2.val FROM (SELECT id FROM t1_a UNION ALL SELECT id FROM t1_b) AS u JOIN t2 ON u.id = t2.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1_a.id, t2.val FROM t1_a JOIN t2 ON t1_a.id = t2.id UNION ALL SELECT t1_b.id, t2.val FROM t1_b JOIN t2 ON t1_b.id = t2.id

description: 当两边都是子查询/投影时，把它们的投影上提到JOIN之上（兼容外连接）。

examples.original_query: SELECT l.x, r.y FROM (SELECT id, a AS x FROM t1) AS l LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, b AS y FROM t2) AS r ON l.id = r.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.a AS x, t2.b AS y FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

description: 只左边是投影时，上提重排以减少不必要的列。

examples.original_query: SELECT l.x, t2.b FROM (SELECT id, a AS x FROM t1) AS l LEFT JOIN t2 ON l.id = t2.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.a AS x, t2.b FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

description: 只右边是投影时，上提重排以减少不必要的列。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.a, r.y FROM t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, b AS y FROM t2) AS r ON t1.id = r.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.a, t2.b AS y FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

description: 把只依赖单边表的JOIN表达式提前为该表的计算列。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.a + 1 AS a_plus_1, t2.val FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1_calc.a_plus_1, t2.val FROM (SELECT id, a + 1 AS a_plus_1 FROM t1) AS t1_calc JOIN t2 ON t1_calc.id = t2.id

description: 在等值连接上利用传递性，把已有的等值或常量谓词推到对侧（如 A.x=B.x 且 A.x=1 ⇒ B.x=1）。只推导等值链上的等值/常量谓词；不要用不等价关系推导新的列间比较。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.id = 5
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.id = 5 AND t2.id = 5
examples.example_description: 等值连接上把常量谓词传到对侧（t1.id=5 ⇒ t2.id=5）。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.*, t3.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id JOIN t3 ON t2.id = t3.id WHERE t1.id = 5
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.*, t3.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id JOIN t3 ON t2.id = t3.id WHERE t1.id = 5 AND t2.id = 5 AND t3.id = 5
examples.example_description: 沿等值链把常量谓词传到所有可达侧。

description: 简化JOIN条件里的常量表达式和冗余计算。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id AND 1 = 1
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id

description: 当右输入是UNION ALL时，把JOIN分发到每个分支，再用UNION合并。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id, u.val FROM t1 JOIN (SELECT id, val FROM t2_a UNION ALL SELECT id, val FROM t2_b) AS u ON t1.id = u.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.id, t2_a.val FROM t1 JOIN t2_a ON t1.id = t2_a.id UNION ALL SELECT t1.id, t2_b.val FROM t1 JOIN t2_b ON t1.id = t2_b.id

description: 当子查询目标表较小或结果集基数较低时，将连接条件中的 IN/EXISTS 子查询改写为 JOIN + DISTINCT。不相关标量子查询先算成单行，再参与连接。相关标量聚合按相关键分组一次，再与外层连接；外层和子查询共用的过滤抽成小结果，两边一起用。只依赖外层、且不依赖聚合结果的谓词，先作用在外层输入上，再算聚合。不要先对全表聚合再过滤，也不要把这次分组改回逐行执行。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id AND t2.val IN (SELECT t3.x FROM t3)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT x FROM t3 WHERE x IS NOT NULL) AS sub_t3 ON t2.val = sub_t3.x
examples.example_description: JOIN条件中的IN子查询改写为JOIN + DISTINCT，避免子查询重复执行。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id AND t2.ref = (SELECT MAX(t3.ref) FROM t3)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(ref) AS max_ref FROM t3) AS sub_t3 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id AND t2.ref = sub_t3.max_ref
examples.example_description: JOIN条件中的标量子查询先计算为单行结果，再作为普通JOIN输入参与连接。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t3 WHERE t3.ref = t2.ref)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ref FROM t3 WHERE ref IS NOT NULL) AS sub_t3 ON t2.ref = sub_t3.ref
examples.example_description: JOIN条件中的EXISTS子查询改写为去重后的半连接形式。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 WHERE t1.kind = 'A' AND t1.cost = (SELECT MIN(t2.cost) FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id)
examples.rewritten_query: WITH kept AS (SELECT t1.* FROM t1 WHERE t1.kind = 'A') SELECT kept.* FROM kept JOIN (SELECT t2.id, MIN(t2.cost) AS min_cost FROM t2 JOIN kept ON t2.id = kept.id GROUP BY t2.id) AS m ON kept.id = m.id AND kept.cost = m.min_cost
examples.example_description: 相关标量聚合按相关键分组；只依赖外层、且不依赖聚合结果的谓词，先作用在外层输入上，再算聚合。不要先对子查询涉及的全表聚合，再连接并过滤。

examples.original_query: SELECT SUM(t1.amt) FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.b = t2.id AND t1.c = t3.id AND t2.flag = 'Y' AND t3.code = 'M' AND t1.amt > (SELECT 1.3 * AVG(x.amt) FROM t1 x, t3 y WHERE x.b = t2.id AND x.c = y.id AND y.code = 'M')
examples.rewritten_query: WITH t2f AS (SELECT id FROM t2 WHERE flag = 'Y'), t3f AS (SELECT id FROM t3 WHERE code = 'M'), avg_amt AS (SELECT t1.b, AVG(t1.amt) AS a FROM t1 JOIN t3f ON t1.c = t3f.id JOIN t2f ON t1.b = t2f.id GROUP BY t1.b) SELECT SUM(t1.amt) FROM t1 JOIN t2f ON t1.b = t2f.id JOIN t3f ON t1.c = t3f.id JOIN avg_amt ON avg_amt.b = t1.b WHERE t1.amt > 1.3 * avg_amt.a
examples.example_description: 相关标量聚合按相关键分组一次。外层和子查询共用的过滤抽成小结果，两边一起用，不要改回逐行执行。

description: 在内侧较小、适合按外侧行查找时，把 JOIN 改写为相关子查询或 LATERAL。不要用本规则把可以按相关键一次分组完成的聚合改成逐行执行。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id, t2.val FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.id, t2_l.val FROM t1 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t2.val FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id) AS t2_l ON TRUE

description: 把仅仅转发列名/别名的投影和聚合合并，减少多余SELECT层。

examples.original_query: SELECT name FROM (SELECT name, salary FROM emp) AS s GROUP BY name
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT name FROM emp GROUP BY name

description: 在相关子查询前后重排投影，以减少传递列或简化结构。

examples.original_query: SELECT q.id, sub_t2.val FROM (SELECT t1.id, t1.name FROM t1) AS q JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t2.val FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = q.id) AS sub_t2 ON TRUE
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.id, sub_t2.val FROM t1 JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t2.val FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id) AS sub_t2 ON TRUE

description: 与Filter组合时，在不改变语义下调整两者顺序以便更好下推。

examples.original_query: SELECT name FROM (SELECT name, age, description FROM employee) AS s WHERE age > 30
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT name FROM (SELECT name, age FROM employee WHERE age > 30) AS s

description: 把对VALUES的投影+过滤合并成一个新的精简VALUES子句。

examples.original_query: SELECT x FROM (VALUES (1), (2)) AS t(x) WHERE x > 1
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM (VALUES (2)) AS t(x)

examples.original_query: SELECT x + 1 AS y FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) AS t(x) WHERE x > 1
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM (VALUES (3), (4)) AS t(y)

description: 在有JOIN + PROJECT的场景中移除对结果无贡献的中间JOIN。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.x FROM t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT id FROM t2 GROUP BY id) AS t2u ON t1.id = t2u.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT id FROM t3 GROUP BY id) AS t3u ON t1.id = t3u.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.x FROM t1

description: 如果LEFT/RIGHT JOIN的一侧列在最终SELECT中不用且不影响语义，就移除该JOIN。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id FROM t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT id FROM t2 GROUP BY id) AS t2u ON t1.id = t2u.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.id FROM t1
examples.example_description: LEFT JOIN右侧列未被最终投影使用，且右侧按键去重不扩行时，可以删除该JOIN。

description: 把投影上提到JOIN之上或下推到左右输入中，只保留后续需要的列。本规则不改JOIN形态：不把逗号连接改成显式JOIN，不改ON/WHERE中的连接条件与连接顺序；只需列裁剪时才用。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id, t2.val FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT l.id, r.val FROM (SELECT id FROM t1) AS l JOIN (SELECT id, val FROM t2) AS r ON l.id = r.id
examples.example_description: JOIN … ON 保持不变，只裁两侧投影列。

description: 合并连续的两层SELECT（投影），减少多余中间层。WITH 若只是一层投影（含确定性表达式），被多处引用时同样合并：每一处引用换成内层查询，再删掉这个 WITH。带聚合、DISTINCT、LIMIT，或先滤成小结果再复用的 CTE 不要合并。

examples.original_query: SELECT a FROM (SELECT a, b FROM t) AS s
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT a FROM t
examples.example_description: 连续两层投影中，外层只需要a列，可合并为一次投影。

examples.original_query: SELECT a_plus_1 FROM (SELECT a + 1 AS a_plus_1, b FROM t) AS s
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT a + 1 AS a_plus_1 FROM t
examples.example_description: 包含表达式别名的连续投影也可合并，保留最终别名。

examples.original_query: WITH p AS (SELECT id, qty * 10 AS units FROM t1) SELECT a.id, a.units + b.units AS pair_units FROM p AS a JOIN p AS b ON b.id = a.id + 1
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT a.id, (a.qty * 10) + (b.qty * 10) AS pair_units FROM t1 AS a JOIN t1 AS b ON b.id = a.id + 1
examples.example_description: CTE 只是带确定性表达式的投影，自连接两侧都引用它。两侧都代入表达式后删掉 WITH。不要展开聚合或先滤成小结果的 CTE。

description: 简化SELECT列中的常量计算、冗余表达式和无用CAST。

examples.original_query: SELECT a + 0 AS a_value, 2 * 3 AS six FROM t
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT a AS a_value, 6 AS six FROM t
examples.example_description: 覆盖SELECT列中的代数恒等式和常量算术折叠。

examples.original_query: SELECT CAST(a AS INTEGER) AS a_value FROM t
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT a AS a_value FROM t
examples.example_description: 覆盖删除目标列已经是INTEGER时的无用CAST。

description: 当外层SELECT只是简单转发列（或纯重命名）时，直接删除这一层。WITH 若只是单表列投影或重命名，并且被引用多次，把每一处引用换回这张表，再删掉这个 WITH。带聚合、DISTINCT、LIMIT，或用来先滤成小结果的 CTE 不要删除。

examples.original_query: SELECT id, name FROM (SELECT id, name FROM t) AS s
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT id, name FROM t
examples.example_description: 外层SELECT仅原样转发列时，删除多余投影层。

examples.original_query: WITH p AS (SELECT id, label FROM t1) SELECT a.label AS curr_label, b.label AS next_label FROM p AS a JOIN p AS b ON b.id = a.id + 1
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT a.label AS curr_label, b.label AS next_label FROM t1 AS a JOIN t1 AS b ON b.id = a.id + 1
examples.example_description: CTE 只转发单表的列，自连接两侧都引用它。两侧都换回基表后删除 WITH，避免先物化再扫两遍。选择性过滤或聚合的 CTE 留着。

description: 在UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT前后重排投影，尽量只对源数据做一次统一的列选择。

examples.original_query: SELECT a + 1 AS a1 FROM (SELECT a FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT a FROM t2) AS u
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT a + 1 AS a1 FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT a + 1 AS a1 FROM t2
examples.example_description: UNION ALL上的投影下推到各分支，保留重复行语义。

description: 把SELECT列中的标量/集合子查询改写为JOIN + 聚合/集合构造。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id, (SELECT MAX(t2.val) FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id) AS max_val FROM t1
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.id, sub_t2.max_val FROM t1 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(t2.val) AS max_val FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id) AS sub_t2 ON TRUE
examples.example_description: SELECT列中的标量聚合子查询改写为LATERAL JOIN，聚合保证每个外层行对应一行结果。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id, ARRAY(SELECT t2.tag FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id ORDER BY t2.tag) AS tags FROM t1
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.id, COALESCE(sub_t2.tags, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS tags FROM t1 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(t2.tag ORDER BY t2.tag) AS tags FROM t2 WHERE t2.id = t1.id) AS sub_t2 ON TRUE
examples.example_description: SELECT列中的集合子查询改写为LATERAL JOIN + ARRAY_AGG；COALESCE保留无匹配时的空数组语义。

description: 把既含普通表达式又含窗口函数的SELECT拆成普通列+外层窗口两层。

examples.original_query: SELECT a + 1 AS a_plus_1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b) AS rank_val FROM t
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT a + 1 AS a_plus_1, rank_val FROM (SELECT a, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b) AS rank_val FROM t) AS s

description: 把投影的列计算直接作用到VALUES里的字面量上，得到新的VALUES。

examples.original_query: SELECT x + 1 AS y FROM (VALUES (1), (2)) AS t(x)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM (VALUES (2), (3)) AS t(y)

description: 在窗口函数前后重排投影，以减小参与窗口计算的数据列数。

examples.original_query: SELECT a + 1 AS a_plus_1, rank_val FROM (SELECT a, b, c, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b) AS rank_val FROM t) AS s
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT a + 1 AS a_plus_1, rank_val FROM (SELECT a, b, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b) AS rank_val FROM t) AS s

description: 把和半连接相关的过滤条件在JOIN和其输入间来回重排以更有效过滤。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 WHERE t1.id IN (SELECT t2.id FROM t2) AND t1.status = 'ACTIVE'
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1_filtered.* FROM (SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS t1_filtered WHERE t1_filtered.id IN (SELECT t2.id FROM t2)

description: 在多表JOIN树中，调整半连接和普通JOIN的相对顺序，优先执行选择性更强的过滤。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.*, t2.* FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id WHERE t1.id IN (SELECT t3.id FROM t3)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1s.*, t2.* FROM (SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE id IN (SELECT t3.id FROM t3)) AS t1s JOIN t2 ON t1s.id = t2.id

description: 在半连接前后移动投影，去掉对后续无用的列。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id FROM t1 WHERE t1.id IN (SELECT t2.id FROM t2)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT t1.id FROM t1 WHERE t1.id IN (SELECT p.id FROM (SELECT id FROM t2) AS p)

description: 当排序只依赖某一侧表列时，把Sort移到该表scan之后、JOIN之前。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.id, t1.col, t2.val FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id ORDER BY t1.col
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT s.id, s.col, t2.val FROM (SELECT id, col FROM t1 ORDER BY col) AS s JOIN t2 ON s.id = t2.id ORDER BY s.col

description: 把只依赖原始列的Sort尽量移到投影之前。

examples.original_query: SELECT a + b AS sum_ab FROM t ORDER BY a
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT sum_ab FROM (SELECT a, a + b AS sum_ab FROM t ORDER BY a) AS s ORDER BY a

description: 删除多余的排序，例如外层与内层排序键相同。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY id) AS s ORDER BY id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY id

description: 去掉排序键中恒定的列，若所有排序键都恒定则删除整个排序。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY ('constant'::text), id
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY id
examples.example_description: 排序键中混有常量和变量时，删除常量排序键。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY ('constant'::text)
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM t
examples.example_description: 所有排序键均为常量时，排序不提供确定性顺序，可删除整个ORDER BY。

description: 把Sort+LIMIT部分下推到UNION ALL的每个分支。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, val FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT id, val FROM t2) AS u ORDER BY id LIMIT 10
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT id, val FROM t1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 10) UNION ALL (SELECT id, val FROM t2 ORDER BY id LIMIT 10)) AS s ORDER BY id LIMIT 10

description: 在UNION+FETCH/OFFSET场景下，下推排序同时严格保证NULL语义。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, val FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT id, val FROM t2) AS u ORDER BY id NULLS LAST FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT id, val FROM t1 ORDER BY id NULLS LAST FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY) UNION ALL (SELECT id, val FROM t2 ORDER BY id NULLS LAST FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY)) AS s ORDER BY id NULLS LAST FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
examples.example_description: 覆盖只有FETCH、没有OFFSET时保持NULL排序语义的Top-N下推。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, val FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT id, val FROM t2) AS u ORDER BY id NULLS LAST OFFSET 1 ROWS FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT id, val FROM t1 ORDER BY id NULLS LAST FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY) UNION ALL (SELECT id, val FROM t2 ORDER BY id NULLS LAST FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY)) AS s ORDER BY id NULLS LAST OFFSET 1 ROWS FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY
examples.example_description: 覆盖带OFFSET+FETCH且需要保持NULL排序语义的Top-N下推。

description: 将可复用的子查询或过滤逻辑提取为标准 CTE (WITH ... AS ...)。过滤放进 CTE；IN 子查询过滤时按连接键去重后外层直接连接，不要在外面再留一层 IN。语义相同的过滤或标量子查询在多处出现时，只定义一次 CTE 并多处引用。选择性条件在小表上时，先滤成小结果再连接大表。过滤对聚合的每一次使用都成立时可放进该聚合；仅部分使用处成立的过滤留在外面，不要复制聚合。

examples.original_query: SELECT l.order_id, p.part_name FROM lineitem AS l JOIN part AS p ON l.part_id = p.part_id WHERE p.type = 'RARE'
examples.rewritten_query: WITH p_filtered AS (SELECT part_id, part_name FROM part WHERE type = 'RARE') SELECT l.order_id, p_filtered.part_name FROM lineitem AS l JOIN p_filtered ON l.part_id = p_filtered.part_id
examples.example_description: 将 JOIN 输入侧的过滤提取为标准 CTE。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.* FROM t1 WHERE t1.id IN (SELECT t2.id FROM t2 WHERE t2.status = 'ACTIVE')
examples.rewritten_query: WITH active_t2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM t2 WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') SELECT t1.* FROM t1 JOIN active_t2 ON t1.id = active_t2.id
examples.example_description: IN 过滤抽成 CTE，按连接键去重后外层直接连接。

examples.original_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.a = t2.id AND t1.b = t3.id AND t2.flag = 'Y' AND t3.code = 'M'
examples.rewritten_query: WITH t2f AS (SELECT id FROM t2 WHERE flag = 'Y'), t3f AS (SELECT id FROM t3 WHERE code = 'M') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 JOIN t2f ON t1.a = t2f.id JOIN t3f ON t1.b = t3f.id
examples.example_description: 小表选择性过滤抽成只含连接键的 CTE，再连接大表。

examples.original_query: SELECT t1.v FROM t1 WHERE t1.d IN (SELECT id FROM dim WHERE flag = 'Y') UNION ALL SELECT t2.v FROM t2 WHERE t2.d IN (SELECT id FROM dim WHERE flag = 'Y')
examples.rewritten_query: WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM dim WHERE flag = 'Y') SELECT t1.v FROM t1 JOIN d ON t1.d = d.id UNION ALL SELECT t2.v FROM t2 JOIN d ON t2.d = d.id
examples.example_description: 多处相同过滤只定义一次 CTE 并多处引用。

examples.original_query: WITH s AS (SELECT deptno, job, SUM(sal) AS total FROM emp GROUP BY deptno, job) SELECT deptno, total FROM s WHERE deptno = 10 AND job = 'CLERK' AND total > (SELECT AVG(s2.total) FROM s s2 WHERE s2.deptno = s.deptno)
examples.rewritten_query: WITH s AS (SELECT deptno, job, SUM(sal) AS total FROM emp WHERE deptno = 10 GROUP BY deptno, job) SELECT deptno, total FROM s WHERE job = 'CLERK' AND total > (SELECT AVG(s2.total) FROM s s2 WHERE s2.deptno = s.deptno)
examples.example_description: 对所有使用处成立的过滤放进聚合；仅部分成立的过滤留在外面。

description: 把各分支SELECT中相同常量列上提到外层，内分支只保留变化的部分。

examples.original_query: SELECT 'A' AS src, id FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT 'A' AS src, id FROM t2
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT 'A' AS src, id FROM (SELECT id FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM t2) AS s

description: 删除冗余的UNION ALL分支，如恒为空的分支。

examples.original_query: SELECT * FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE 1 = 0
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM t1

description: 把UNION（去重）改写为UNION ALL再在外层做DISTINCT。

examples.original_query: SELECT id FROM t1 UNION SELECT id FROM t2
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT DISTINCT id FROM (SELECT id FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM t2) AS s

description: 简化窗口函数里的常量表达式或冗余计算。

examples.original_query: SELECT SUM(1 + 0) OVER (PARTITION BY deptno) AS cnt_like_sum FROM emp
examples.rewritten_query: SELECT SUM(1) OVER (PARTITION BY deptno) AS cnt_like_sum FROM emp
